top_signals.title: QatarEnergy Adds Chevron Block to Stakes in African Oil Hotspot
top_signals.summary: QatarEnergy agreed to take a stake in an offshore oil block held by Chevron Corp. in Namibia, adding to its holdings in the African exploration hotspot.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
top_signals.summary: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Private equity firm seeks to take control of LIV Golf from Saudi wealth fund
top_signals.summary: BC Partners looks to purchase Public Investment Fund’s bankruptcy loan in order to revive failed golf league assets
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BMW Widens Battery Component Suppliers With Samsung, LG Energy
top_signals.summary: BMW AG is adding South Korean battery-cell makers Samsung SDI Co. and LG Energy Solution Ltd. to its supplier networks in Europe and the US as the German carmaker looks to reduce dependencies.
